prompt: Write a custom React hook that manages form state for a login form with email and password fields, including basic validation.

assertions.text: The hook handles form state and validation only — no network calls, no rendering, no side effects beyond state
The hook has a descriptive name starting with 'use' that makes its purpose clear (e.g. useLoginForm, not useForm)
Both email and password fields have validation with clear rules (email format, password length/requirements)
The hook returns a clear, usable object with values, errors, and handler functions
Validation errors are shown in a UX-aware way — errors don't appear before the user has interacted (touched state or similar)
